import logging
import sqlite3
import uuid
from contextlib import contextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import Request

logger = logging.getLogger("cardboard.db")

SCHEMA_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("schema.sql")
SCHEMA_VERSION = 2


def new_id() -> str:
    return str(uuid.uuid4())


def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="microseconds")


def open_conn(db_path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    # isolation_level=None: 交易由 session() 明確控制，避免 sqlite3 模組隱式開關交易
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, isolation_level=None, check_same_thread=False, timeout=10)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")  # 每個連線都必須開
    conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 10000")
    return conn


def _migrate_v1_to_v2(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """將 v1 資料庫無損遷移至 v2：domain -> location，新增 card_type/curation_status/facet/definition/tag_aliases。"""
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF")
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            card_cols = {r["name"] for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(cards)")}
            if "card_type" not in card_cols:
                conn.execute(
                    "ALTER TABLE cards ADD COLUMN card_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'untyped' "
                    "CHECK (card_type IN ('untyped', 'concept', 'mechanism', 'hypothesis', 'method', 'case', 'source', 'question'))"
                )
            if "curation_status" not in card_cols:
                conn.execute(
                    "ALTER TABLE cards ADD COLUMN curation_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inbox' "
                    "CHECK (curation_status IN ('inbox', 'curated'))"
                )
            conn.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cards_curation ON cards (curation_status)")
            conn.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cards_type ON cards (card_type)")

            conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE tags_v2 (
                    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    name       TEXT NOT NULL,
                    axis       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (axis IN ('location', 'domain', 'type', 'concept', 'free')),
                    facet      TEXT,
                    definition TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    parent_id  TEXT REFERENCES tags_v2 (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                    CHECK (axis NOT IN ('free', 'concept') OR parent_id IS NULL)
                )
                """
            )
            tag_cols = {r["name"] for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(tags)")}
            facet_expr = "facet" if "facet" in tag_cols else "NULL"
            def_expr = "definition" if "definition" in tag_cols else "''"
            conn.execute(
                f"""
                INSERT INTO tags_v2 (id, name, axis, facet, definition, parent_id, created_at)
                SELECT id, name,
                       CASE WHEN axis = 'domain' THEN 'location' ELSE axis END,
                       {facet_expr}, {def_expr}, parent_id, created_at
                FROM tags
                """
            )
            conn.execute("DROP TABLE tags")
            conn.execute("ALTER TABLE tags_v2 RENAME TO tags")
            conn.execute(
                "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tags_sibling ON tags (parent_id, name) WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL"
            )
            conn.execute(
                "CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tags_root ON tags (axis, COALESCE(facet, ''), name) WHERE parent_id IS NULL"
            )
            conn.execute("CREATE INDEX idx_tags_parent ON tags (parent_id)")

            conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tag_aliases (
                    alias      TEXT PRIMARY KEY COLLATE NOCASE,
                    tag_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
                )
                """
            )
            conn.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tag_aliases_tag ON tag_aliases (tag_id)")

            link_cols = {r["name"] for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(links)")}
            if not link_cols:
                conn.execute(
                    """
                    CREATE TABLE links (
                        source_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                        target_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                        relation_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'extend'
                                      CHECK (relation_type IN ('support', 'refute', 'influence', 'instance_of', 'applied_to', 'extend')),
                        status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed'
                                      CHECK (status IN ('confirmed', 'hypothesis')),
                        reason        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                        created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
                        PRIMARY KEY (source_id, target_id, relation_type),
                        CHECK (source_id <> target_id)
                    )
                    """
                )
                conn.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_links_target ON links (target_id)")
            elif "source_id" not in link_cols:
                conn.execute(
                    """
                    CREATE TABLE links_v2 (
                        source_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                        target_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                        relation_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'extend'
                                      CHECK (relation_type IN ('support', 'refute', 'influence', 'instance_of', 'applied_to', 'extend')),
                        status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed'
                                      CHECK (status IN ('confirmed', 'hypothesis')),
                        reason        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                        created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
                        PRIMARY KEY (source_id, target_id, relation_type),
                        CHECK (source_id <> target_id)
                    )
                    """
                )
                conn.execute(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO links_v2 (source_id, target_id, relation_type, status, reason, created_at)
                    SELECT card_a, card_b, 'extend', 'confirmed', '', created_at FROM links
                    """
                )
                conn.execute("DROP TABLE links")
                conn.execute("ALTER TABLE links_v2 RENAME TO links")
                conn.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_links_target ON links (target_id)")

            conn.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS board_groups (
                    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    board_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES boards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                    label      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    x          REAL NOT NULL,
                    y          REAL NOT NULL,
                    w          REAL NOT NULL CHECK (w > 0),
                    h          REAL NOT NULL CHECK (h > 0),
                    color      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'slate',
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
                )
                """
            )
            conn.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_board_groups_board ON board_groups (board_id)")

            fk_errors = conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall()
            if fk_errors:
                raise RuntimeError(f"v1 -> v2 遷移外鍵檢查失敗：{fk_errors}")
            conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version = 2")
            conn.execute("COMMIT")
        except BaseException:
            conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise
    finally:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")


# 橋樑詞關係句型表（第一版僅電腦端、不納入同步）。與 schema.sql 同文，修改時兩處一起改；
# 全部使用 IF NOT EXISTS 且每次啟動都執行：既有資料庫靠這裡補表，不升 SCHEMA_VERSION
RELATION_TABLES_DDL = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS relation_patterns (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    label         TEXT NOT NULL,
    template      TEXT NOT NULL,
    bridge_tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    note          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    family        TEXT,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_relation_patterns_label ON relation_patterns (label);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_relation_patterns_tag ON relation_patterns (bridge_tag_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS card_relations (
    card_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    pattern_id    TEXT REFERENCES relation_patterns (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    role_a        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    role_b        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    result        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    free_sentence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((pattern_id IS NULL) <> (free_sentence = ''))
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_card_relations_pattern ON card_relations (pattern_id);
"""


def _ensure_relation_tables(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    conn.executescript(RELATION_TABLES_DDL)
    # CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS 不會替既有的舊資料表補欄位：舊版 relation_patterns 沒有 family，這裡檢查後補上
    pattern_cols = {r["name"] for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(relation_patterns)")}
    if "family" not in pattern_cols:
        conn.execute("ALTER TABLE relation_patterns ADD COLUMN family TEXT")


def _ensure_card_sources(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """cards.sources：出處清單，JSON 陣列字串。比照 relation_patterns.family，每次啟動檢查並補欄位，不升 SCHEMA_VERSION。"""
    card_cols = {r["name"] for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(cards)")}
    if "sources" not in card_cols:
        conn.execute("ALTER TABLE cards ADD COLUMN sources TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'")


def init_db(db_path: Path) -> None:
    db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    conn = open_conn(db_path)
    try:
        has_cards = conn.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='cards'"
        ).fetchone()
        if not has_cards:
            conn.executescript(SCHEMA_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            conn.execute(f"PRAGMA user_version = {SCHEMA_VERSION}")
        version = conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]
        card_cols = {r["name"] for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(cards)")}
        tag_cols = {r["name"] for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(tags)")}
        link_cols = {r["name"] for r in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(links)")}
        has_groups = conn.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='board_groups'"
        ).fetchone()
        if (
            version in (1, 3)
            or "card_type" not in card_cols
            or "facet" not in tag_cols
            or "source_id" not in link_cols
            or not has_groups
        ):
            _migrate_v1_to_v2(conn)
            version = conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]
        _ensure_relation_tables(conn)
        _ensure_card_sources(conn)
        if version != SCHEMA_VERSION:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"資料庫 schema 版本為 {version}，程式預期 {SCHEMA_VERSION}；請先處理遷移，不要直接使用"
            )
    finally:
        conn.close()


@contextmanager
def session(request: Request, write: bool):
    """一個請求一個連線、一個交易。例外一律回滾後再往上拋。"""
    conn = open_conn(request.app.state.settings.db_path)
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE" if write else "BEGIN")
        try:
            yield conn
        except BaseException:
            try:
                conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
            except sqlite3.Error:
                logger.error("ROLLBACK 失敗", exc_info=True)
            raise
        else:
            conn.execute("COMMIT")
    finally:
        conn.close()


def descendant_ids(conn: sqlite3.Connection, tag_id: str) -> list[str]:
    """含自己的所有後代。用 UNION（不是 UNION ALL）去重，即使資料異常也不會無窮迴圈。"""
    rows = conn.execute(
        """
        WITH RECURSIVE sub(id) AS (
            SELECT ?
            UNION
            SELECT t.id FROM tags t JOIN sub s ON t.parent_id = s.id
        )
        SELECT id FROM sub
        """,
        (tag_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    return [r["id"] for r in rows]


def is_unique_violation(exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError) -> bool:
    return "UNIQUE constraint failed" in str(exc)

from enum import Enum
from typing import Annotated, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, StringConstraints

Name = Annotated[str, StringConstraints(strip_whitespace=True, min_length=1, max_length=200)]
Id = Annotated[str, StringConstraints(min_length=1, max_length=64)]
Coord = Annotated[float, Field(allow_inf_nan=False)]
Size = Annotated[float, Field(gt=0, allow_inf_nan=False)]
Sources = Annotated[list[Annotated[str, StringConstraints(max_length=2000)]], Field(max_length=20)]


class Axis(str, Enum):
    LOCATION = "location"
    DOMAIN = "domain"  # 向後相容別名，寫入時正規化為 location
    TYPE = "type"
    CONCEPT = "concept"
    FREE = "free"

    def normalized(self) -> str:
        if self == Axis.DOMAIN:
            return Axis.LOCATION.value
        return self.value


class CardType(str, Enum):
    UNTYPED = "untyped"
    CONCEPT = "concept"
    MECHANISM = "mechanism"
    HYPOTHESIS = "hypothesis"
    METHOD = "method"
    CASE = "case"
    SOURCE = "source"
    QUESTION = "question"


class CurationStatus(str, Enum):
    INBOX = "inbox"
    CURATED = "curated"


class CardCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field("", max_length=500)
    body: str = ""
    card_type: CardType = CardType.UNTYPED
    curation_status: CurationStatus = CurationStatus.INBOX
    tag_ids: list[Id] = []


class CardPatch(BaseModel):
    title: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=500)
    body: Optional[str] = None
    card_type: Optional[CardType] = None
    curation_status: Optional[CurationStatus] = None
    sources: Optional[Sources] = None  # None＝不變更；[] 代表清空
    expected_updated_at: str


class TagCreate(BaseModel):
    name: Name
    axis: Axis
    facet: Optional[Name] = None
    definition: str = Field("", max_length=1000)
    parent_id: Optional[Id] = None


class TagPatch(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[Name] = None
    facet: Optional[Name] = None
    definition: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=1000)
    parent_id: Optional[Id] = None  # 明確傳 null 代表移到最上層（用 model_fields_set 判斷有沒有傳）


class TagAliasCreate(BaseModel):
    alias: Name


class TagResolveRequest(BaseModel):
    query: Name
    axis: Optional[Axis] = None


class TagMergeRequest(BaseModel):
    target_id: Id


class RelationType(str, Enum):
    SUPPORT = "support"
    REFUTE = "refute"
    INFLUENCE = "influence"
    INSTANCE_OF = "instance_of"
    APPLIED_TO = "applied_to"
    EXTEND = "extend"


class LinkStatus(str, Enum):
    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
    HYPOTHESIS = "hypothesis"


class LinkPut(BaseModel):
    source_id: Optional[Id] = None
    target_id: Optional[Id] = None
    card_id: Optional[Id] = None  # 相容舊呼叫端
    other_id: Optional[Id] = None  # 相容舊呼叫端
    relation_type: RelationType = RelationType.EXTEND
    status: LinkStatus = LinkStatus.CONFIRMED
    reason: str = Field("", max_length=1000)


class LinkPatch(BaseModel):
    old_relation_type: Optional[RelationType] = None
    relation_type: Optional[RelationType] = None
    status: Optional[LinkStatus] = None
    reason: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=1000)


class BoardGroupCreate(BaseModel):
    label: str = Field("", max_length=200)
    x: Coord
    y: Coord
    w: Size = 360.0
    h: Size = 240.0
    color: str = Field("slate", max_length=32)


class BoardGroupPatch(BaseModel):
    label: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=200)
    x: Optional[Coord] = None
    y: Optional[Coord] = None
    w: Optional[Size] = None
    h: Optional[Size] = None
    color: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=32)


class BoardCreate(BaseModel):
    name: Name


class BoardPatch(BaseModel):
    name: Name


class BoardCardAdd(BaseModel):
    card_id: Id
    x: Coord
    y: Coord
    w: Optional[Size] = None
    h: Optional[Size] = None


class BoardCardPos(BaseModel):
    card_id: Id
    x: Coord
    y: Coord
    w: Optional[Size] = None
    h: Optional[Size] = None


class BoardCardsPatch(BaseModel):
    items: list[BoardCardPos] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)


class SyncCardItem(BaseModel):
    id: Id
    title: str = ""
    body: str = ""
    card_type: CardType = CardType.UNTYPED
    curation_status: CurationStatus = CurationStatus.INBOX
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str
    sources: Optional[Sources] = None  # 舊版封包沒有此欄：None＝套用更新時不動現有出處


class SyncTagItem(BaseModel):
    id: Id
    name: str
    axis: Axis
    facet: Optional[str] = None
    definition: str = ""
    parent_id: Optional[Id] = None
    aliases: list[str] = []


class SyncCardTagItem(BaseModel):
    card_id: Id
    tag_id: Id


class SyncLinkItem(BaseModel):
    source_id: Id
    target_id: Id
    relation_type: RelationType = RelationType.EXTEND
    status: LinkStatus = LinkStatus.CONFIRMED
    reason: str = ""


class SyncBoardItem(BaseModel):
    id: Id
    name: str


class SyncBoardCardItem(BaseModel):
    board_id: Id
    card_id: Id
    x: Optional[float] = None
    y: Optional[float] = None
    w: Optional[float] = None
    h: Optional[float] = None


class SyncPackage(BaseModel):
    version: int = 1
    exported_at: str
    source_device: str = "pc"
    cards: list[SyncCardItem] = []
    tags: list[SyncTagItem] = []
    card_tags: list[SyncCardTagItem] = []
    links: list[SyncLinkItem] = []
    boards: list[SyncBoardItem] = []
    board_cards: list[SyncBoardCardItem] = []


class SyncApplyRequest(BaseModel):
    card_ids_to_add: list[Id] = []
    card_ids_to_update: list[Id] = []
    tag_ids_to_add: list[Id] = []
    tag_ids_to_update: list[Id] = []
    card_tags_to_add: list[SyncCardTagItem] = []
    links_to_add: list[SyncLinkItem] = []
    board_cards_to_add: list[SyncBoardCardItem] = []
    package: SyncPackage


class PatternFamily(str, Enum):
    """關係句型的導引分類。值必須與前端 types.ts 的 PatternFamily、種子腳本一致；資料庫不設 CHECK，只由此列舉把關。"""

    FAILURE = "failure"  # 失效與承載
    CONSTRAINT = "constraint"  # 卡住與限制
    FEEDBACK = "feedback"  # 回饋與調節
    CHANGE = "change"  # 變化的形狀
    EVIDENCE = "evidence"  # 判讀與證據


class RelationPatternCreate(BaseModel):
    label: Name
    template: str = Field(max_length=1000)
    bridge_tag_id: Id
    note: str = Field("", max_length=1000)
    family: Optional[PatternFamily] = None


class RelationPatternPatch(BaseModel):
    label: Optional[Name] = None
    template: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=1000)
    note: Optional[str] = Field(None, max_length=1000)
    family: Optional[PatternFamily] = None  # None＝不變更；目前不支援清回未分類


class CardRelationPut(BaseModel):
    pattern_id: Optional[Id] = None
    role_a: str = Field("", max_length=1000)
    role_b: str = Field("", max_length=1000)
    result: str = Field("", max_length=1000)
    free_sentence: str = Field("", max_length=1000)


```

from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Optional


class ErrorCode(str, Enum):
    NOT_FOUND = "NOT_FOUND"
    VALIDATION_ERROR = "VALIDATION_ERROR"
    NAME_CONFLICT = "NAME_CONFLICT"
    AXIS_MISMATCH = "AXIS_MISMATCH"
    CYCLE_DETECTED = "CYCLE_DETECTED"
    CARD_ALREADY_ON_BOARD = "CARD_ALREADY_ON_BOARD"
    STALE_VERSION = "STALE_VERSION"
    IN_USE = "IN_USE"
    MEDIA_TOO_LARGE = "MEDIA_TOO_LARGE"
    UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA = "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA"
    MEDIA_FILE_MISSING = "MEDIA_FILE_MISSING"
    INTERNAL_ERROR = "INTERNAL_ERROR"


HTTP_STATUS = {
    ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND: 404,
    ErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR: 422,
    ErrorCode.NAME_CONFLICT: 409,
    ErrorCode.AXIS_MISMATCH: 409,
    ErrorCode.CYCLE_DETECTED: 409,
    ErrorCode.CARD_ALREADY_ON_BOARD: 409,
    ErrorCode.STALE_VERSION: 409,
    ErrorCode.IN_USE: 409,
    ErrorCode.MEDIA_TOO_LARGE: 413,
    ErrorCode.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA: 415,
    ErrorCode.MEDIA_FILE_MISSING: 404,
    ErrorCode.INTERNAL_ERROR: 500,
}


class AppError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code: ErrorCode, message: str, details: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code
        self.message = message
        self.details = details or {}

    @property
    def status(self) -> int:
        return HTTP_STATUS[self.code]

    def to_body(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"error": {"code": self.code.value, "message": self.message, "details": self.details}}

# @depends-on .schemas (CardRelationPut, RelationPatternCreate, RelationPatternPatch；欄位與前端 types.ts 同名)
# @depends-on .tags (FLAT_AXES)
# @depends-on .db (RELATION_TABLES_DDL 建立的 relation_patterns／card_relations，與 schema.sql 同文)
# @depends-on .errors (ErrorCode.IN_USE)
# @depends-on .schemas (CardRelationPut, PatternFamily, RelationPatternCreate, RelationPatternPatch；欄位與前端 types.ts 同名，family 值與前端 PatternFamily 一致)
# @depends-on tags.py 的 merge_tag／delete_tag（對 relation_patterns.bridge_tag_id 的改指與守衛）
import re
import sqlite3
from typing import Any, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request

from .db import is_unique_violation, new_id, session, utc_now
from .errors import AppError, ErrorCode
from .schemas import Axis, CardRelationPut, RelationPatternCreate, RelationPatternPatch
from .tags import FLAT_AXES

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api")

LOCATION_AXES = (Axis.LOCATION.value, Axis.DOMAIN.value)
PLACEHOLDERS = {"A", "B", "結果"}
_PLACEHOLDER_RE = re.compile(r"\{([^{}]*)\}")

_PATTERN_SELECT = """
    SELECT rp.id, rp.label, rp.template, rp.bridge_tag_id, rp.note, rp.family, t.name AS bridge_name,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card_relations cr WHERE cr.pattern_id = rp.id) AS use_count
    FROM relation_patterns rp JOIN tags t ON t.id = rp.bridge_tag_id
"""


def _label_conflict(label: str) -> AppError:
    return AppError(ErrorCode.NAME_CONFLICT, f"已有名為「{label}」的關係句型", {"names": [label]})


def _check_template(template: str) -> str:
    text = template.strip()
    found = _PLACEHOLDER_RE.findall(text)
    unknown = sorted({p for p in found if p not in PLACEHOLDERS})
    if not found or unknown:
        raise AppError(
            ErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR,
            "句型模板至少要有一個佔位符，且只能使用 {A}、{B}、{結果}",
            {"unknown": unknown},
        )
    return text


def _pattern(conn: sqlite3.Connection, pattern_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = conn.execute(_PATTERN_SELECT + " WHERE rp.id = ?", (pattern_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise AppError(ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, "關係句型不存在", {"pattern_id": pattern_id})
    return dict(row)


def _require_card(conn: sqlite3.Connection, card_id: str) -> None:
    if conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM cards WHERE id = ?", (card_id,)).fetchone() is None:
        raise AppError(ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, "卡片不存在", {"card_id": card_id})


def _relation(conn: sqlite3.Connection, card_id: str) -> Optional[dict[str, Any]]:
    row = conn.execute(
        """SELECT card_id, pattern_id, role_a, role_b, result, free_sentence, updated_at
           FROM card_relations WHERE card_id = ?""",
        (card_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    return dict(row) if row is not None else None


@router.get("/relation-patterns")
def list_patterns(request: Request):
    with session(request, write=False) as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(_PATTERN_SELECT + " ORDER BY rp.label").fetchall()
        return {"patterns": [dict(r) for r in rows]}


@router.post("/relation-patterns", status_code=201)
def create_pattern(payload: RelationPatternCreate, request: Request):
    template = _check_template(payload.template)
    with session(request, write=True) as conn:
        tag = conn.execute("SELECT axis FROM tags WHERE id = ?", (payload.bridge_tag_id,)).fetchone()
        if tag is None:
            raise AppError(ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, "橋樑詞標籤不存在", {"tag_id": payload.bridge_tag_id})
        if tag["axis"] not in FLAT_AXES:
            raise AppError(ErrorCode.AXIS_MISMATCH, "橋樑詞必須是概念標籤")
        pid = new_id()
        try:
            conn.execute(
                """INSERT INTO relation_patterns (id, label, template, bridge_tag_id, note, family, created_at)
                   VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                (
                    pid,
                    payload.label,
                    template,
                    payload.bridge_tag_id,
                    payload.note.strip(),
                    payload.family.value if payload.family is not None else None,
                    utc_now(),
                ),
            )
        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
            if is_unique_violation(e):
                raise _label_conflict(payload.label) from e
            raise
        return _pattern(conn, pid)


@router.patch("/relation-patterns/{pattern_id}")
def patch_pattern(pattern_id: str, payload: RelationPatternPatch, request: Request):
    if (
        payload.label is None
        and payload.template is None
        and payload.note is None
        and payload.family is None
    ):
        raise AppError(ErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR, "至少要提供一個要修改的欄位")
    template = _check_template(payload.template) if payload.template is not None else None
    with session(request, write=True) as conn:
        cur = _pattern(conn, pattern_id)
        label = payload.label if payload.label is not None else cur["label"]
        note = payload.note.strip() if payload.note is not None else cur["note"]
        family = payload.family.value if payload.family is not None else cur["family"]
        try:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE relation_patterns SET label = ?, template = ?, note = ?, family = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (label, template if template is not None else cur["template"], note, family, pattern_id),
            )
        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as e:
            if is_unique_violation(e):
                raise _label_conflict(label) from e
            raise
        return _pattern(conn, pattern_id)


@router.delete("/relation-patterns/{pattern_id}")
def delete_pattern(pattern_id: str, request: Request):
    with session(request, write=True) as conn:
        cur = _pattern(conn, pattern_id)
        if cur["use_count"]:
            raise AppError(
                ErrorCode.IN_USE,
                f"仍有 {cur['use_count']} 張卡片的紀錄使用這個句型，不能刪除",
                {"use_count": cur["use_count"]},
            )
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM relation_patterns WHERE id = ?", (pattern_id,))
        return {"deleted": True}


@router.get("/cards/{card_id}/relation")
def get_card_relation(card_id: str, request: Request):
    with session(request, write=False) as conn:
        _require_card(conn, card_id)
        return {"relation": _relation(conn, card_id)}


@router.put("/cards/{card_id}/relation")
def put_card_relation(card_id: str, payload: CardRelationPut, request: Request):
    free = payload.free_sentence.strip()
    if payload.pattern_id is not None and free:
        raise AppError(ErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR, "已選句型時，自由關係句必須留空")
    if payload.pattern_id is None and not free:
        raise AppError(ErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR, "未選句型時，必須填寫自由關係句（進入候選池）")
    with session(request, write=True) as conn:
        _require_card(conn, card_id)
        if payload.pattern_id is not None:
            _pattern(conn, payload.pattern_id)  # 句型不存在時丟 NOT_FOUND
        conn.execute(
            """INSERT INTO card_relations (card_id, pattern_id, role_a, role_b, result, free_sentence, updated_at)
               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
               ON CONFLICT(card_id) DO UPDATE SET
                   pattern_id = excluded.pattern_id, role_a = excluded.role_a, role_b = excluded.role_b,
                   result = excluded.result, free_sentence = excluded.free_sentence,
                   updated_at = excluded.updated_at""",
            (
                card_id,
                payload.pattern_id,
                payload.role_a.strip(),
                payload.role_b.strip(),
                payload.result.strip(),
                free,
                utc_now(),
            ),
        )
        return {"relation": _relation(conn, card_id)}


@router.delete("/cards/{card_id}/relation")
def delete_card_relation(card_id: str, request: Request):
    with session(request, write=True) as conn:
        _require_card(conn, card_id)
        cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM card_relations WHERE card_id = ?", (card_id,))
        if cur.rowcount == 0:
            raise AppError(ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND, "這張卡片沒有關係句紀錄", {"card_id": card_id})
        return {"removed": True}


@router.get("/relations/report")
def relations_report(request: Request):
    """唯讀評估報告：橋樑詞分布、紀錄與標籤不一致、候選池。不寫入任何資料。
    cabinet_count 是涉及的最上層收納位置（櫃子）數，只是領域數的上界，是否真的跨領域由人判斷。"""
    with session(request, write=False) as conn:
        total_cards = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cards").fetchone()["n"]
        bridge_rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT ct.card_id) AS card_count
               FROM tags t LEFT JOIN card_tags ct ON ct.tag_id = t.id
               WHERE t.id IN (SELECT bridge_tag_id FROM relation_patterns)
               GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY card_count DESC, t.name"""
        ).fetchall()
        # 卡片只掛在最細的那一格，所以從最上層往下展開，把每個位置對應到它的櫃子
        cabinet_rows = conn.execute(
            """WITH RECURSIVE up(tag_id, root_id) AS (
                   SELECT id, id FROM tags WHERE axis IN (?, ?) AND parent_id IS NULL
                   UNION
                   SELECT t.id, up.root_id FROM tags t JOIN up ON t.parent_id = up.tag_id
               )
               SELECT bct.tag_id AS bridge_id, up.root_id AS cabinet_id, r.name AS cabinet_name,
                      COUNT(DISTINCT bct.card_id) AS card_count
               FROM card_tags bct
               JOIN card_tags lct ON lct.card_id = bct.card_id
               JOIN up ON up.tag_id = lct.tag_id
               JOIN tags r ON r.id = up.root_id
               WHERE bct.tag_id IN (SELECT bridge_tag_id FROM relation_patterns)
               GROUP BY bct.tag_id, up.root_id
               ORDER BY card_count DESC, cabinet_name""",
            LOCATION_AXES,
        ).fetchall()
        unfiled_rows = conn.execute(
            """SELECT bct.tag_id AS bridge_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bct.card_id) AS n
               FROM card_tags bct
               WHERE bct.tag_id IN (SELECT bridge_tag_id FROM relation_patterns)
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM card_tags lct JOIN tags lt ON lt.id = lct.tag_id
                     WHERE lct.card_id = bct.card_id AND lt.axis IN (?, ?))
               GROUP BY bct.tag_id""",
            LOCATION_AXES,
        ).fetchall()
        inconsistencies = conn.execute(
            """SELECT cr.card_id, c.title, rp.id AS pattern_id, rp.label AS pattern_label,
                      rp.bridge_tag_id, t.name AS bridge_name
               FROM card_relations cr
               JOIN cards c ON c.id = cr.card_id
               JOIN relation_patterns rp ON rp.id = cr.pattern_id
               JOIN tags t ON t.id = rp.bridge_tag_id
               WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM card_tags ct WHERE ct.card_id = cr.card_id AND ct.tag_id = rp.bridge_tag_id)
               ORDER BY c.title"""
        ).fetchall()
        candidates = conn.execute(
            """SELECT cr.card_id, c.title, cr.free_sentence, cr.updated_at
               FROM card_relations cr JOIN cards c ON c.id = cr.card_id
               WHERE cr.pattern_id IS NULL ORDER BY cr.updated_at DESC"""
        ).fetchall()

        cabinets: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
        for r in cabinet_rows:
            cabinets.setdefault(r["bridge_id"], []).append(
                {"id": r["cabinet_id"], "name": r["cabinet_name"], "card_count": r["card_count"]}
            )
        unfiled = {r["bridge_id"]: r["n"] for r in unfiled_rows}
        bridges = [
            {
                "id": b["id"],
                "name": b["name"],
                "card_count": b["card_count"],
                "card_ratio": round(b["card_count"] / total_cards, 4) if total_cards else 0.0,
                "unfiled_count": unfiled.get(b["id"], 0),
                "cabinet_count": len(cabinets.get(b["id"], [])),
                "cabinets": cabinets.get(b["id"], []),
            }
            for b in bridge_rows
        ]
        return {
            "total_cards": total_cards,
            "bridges": bridges,
            "inconsistencies": [dict(r) for r in inconsistencies],
            "candidates": [dict(r) for r in candidates],
        }
```

```sql:schema.sql
-- 卡片／白板軟體 資料結構（SQLite）
-- 每個資料庫連線都必須執行這兩行，否則外鍵約束不會生效
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;

-- ============================================================
-- 卡片：內文為 Markdown。圖片與影片以 ![](media:<media.id>) 行內引用；
-- 內文是「這張卡片用了哪些媒體」的唯一真相，不另設使用清單表（避免兩處不同步）。
-- 卡片之間的連結不放在內文，只存在 links 表
-- card_type：卡片型態（untyped/concept/mechanism/hypothesis/method/case/source/question）
-- curation_status：整理狀態（inbox＝待整理收件夾、curated＝已整理）
-- source_system/source_id：記錄這張卡片是從外部資料庫的哪一筆複製來的，
-- 用來避免同一筆被重複複製、並能回頭查原始出處；兩者同時有值或同時為空。
-- 不需要追溯來源的話，這兩欄與 uq_cards_source 可整組刪掉
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE cards (
    id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                 -- UUID 字串
    title           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    body            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    card_type       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'untyped'
                    CHECK (card_type IN ('untyped', 'concept', 'mechanism', 'hypothesis', 'method', 'case', 'source', 'question')),
    curation_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inbox'
                    CHECK (curation_status IN ('inbox', 'curated')),
    source_system   TEXT,
    source_id       TEXT,
    created_at      TEXT NOT NULL,                    -- ISO 8601 UTC
    updated_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((source_system IS NULL) = (source_id IS NULL))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_cards_source
    ON cards (source_system, source_id) WHERE source_system IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_cards_curation ON cards (curation_status);
CREATE INDEX idx_cards_type ON cards (card_type);

-- ============================================================
-- 媒體：檔案放磁碟（以 sha256 命名去重），資料庫只存描述
-- 同一檔案可被多張卡片使用。孤兒＝id 沒有出現在任何卡片內文的媒體。
-- 只由「手動清理」功能刪除，不自動刪；清理時先列出清單讓人確認，
-- 並略過建立不到 24 小時的檔案（貼上圖片後、卡片尚未存檔時也會暫時像孤兒）
-- 內文引用了不存在的 media id 時，介面要顯示「圖片遺失」，不能顯示成空白
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE media (
    id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    sha256      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('image', 'video')),
    mime        TEXT NOT NULL,
    rel_path    TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- 相對於媒體資料夾
    byte_size   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    width       INTEGER,
    height      INTEGER,
    duration_ms INTEGER,                            -- 僅影片
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- ============================================================
-- 卡片連結（有向具名關係）：表達 source_id -> target_id 的明確語意關係
-- relation_type：support（支持）、refute（反駁）、influence（可能影響）、
--                instance_of（是……的實例）、applied_to（應用於）、extend（延伸／補充）
-- status：confirmed（已確認）、hypothesis（待驗證假說）；系統推薦在接受前不寫入此表
-- reason：連接理由（選填，說明為何兩張卡片存在此關係）
-- 以 (source_id, target_id, relation_type) 為複合主鍵，允許同對卡片具備不同類型關係
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE links (
    source_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    target_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    relation_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'extend'
                  CHECK (relation_type IN ('support', 'refute', 'influence', 'instance_of', 'applied_to', 'extend')),
    status        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed'
                  CHECK (status IN ('confirmed', 'hypothesis')),
    reason        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (source_id, target_id, relation_type),
    CHECK (source_id <> target_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_links_target ON links (target_id);

-- ============================================================
-- 標籤（收納位置與概念標籤）：
-- axis：location（相容舊名 domain）＝收納位置（櫃子／抽屜／小格，樹狀，單一父節點）、
--       type＝類型軸（選填）、concept（相容舊名 free）＝概念標籤（扁平，無父節點，可附 facet 分面維度與 definition 定義）
-- 子節點的 axis 必須與父節點相同；移動節點時不可跨軸、不可移到自己的後代底下
--   → 這兩項由應用程式在交易內檢查，不在此處約束
-- parent_id 與 card_tags.tag_id 用 RESTRICT：直接 DELETE tags 會失敗，
-- 逼所有刪除都走下面的「刪除標籤程序」，避免默默留下錯誤狀態
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE tags (
    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name       TEXT NOT NULL,
    axis       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (axis IN ('location', 'domain', 'type', 'concept', 'free')),
    facet      TEXT,
    definition TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    parent_id  TEXT REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK (axis NOT IN ('free', 'concept') OR parent_id IS NULL)
);
-- SQLite 的 UNIQUE 把多個 NULL 視為不同，所以最上層與非最上層要分開約束
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tags_sibling
    ON tags (parent_id, name) WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_tags_root
    ON tags (axis, COALESCE(facet, ''), name) WHERE parent_id IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_tags_parent ON tags (parent_id);

-- 標籤別名表：用於輸入自動解析、搜尋擴展與同義標籤合併後保留舊名稱
CREATE TABLE tag_aliases (
    alias      TEXT PRIMARY KEY COLLATE NOCASE,
    tag_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_tag_aliases_tag ON tag_aliases (tag_id);

-- 卡片只存放在最細的那一格；查上層時用遞迴查詢帶出所有後代，不重複儲存
CREATE TABLE card_tags (
    card_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tag_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    PRIMARY KEY (card_id, tag_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_card_tags_tag ON card_tags (tag_id);

-- ============================================================
-- 白板：只存「位置」，卡片本體不複製
-- 同一張卡片在同一塊白板只能出現一次
-- 從白板移除＝只刪 board_cards 那一列；刪卡片＝由外鍵連鎖刪除所有白板上的位置
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE boards (
    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    name       TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE board_cards (
    board_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES boards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    card_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    x        REAL NOT NULL,
    y        REAL NOT NULL,
    w        REAL,
    h        REAL,
    z        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (board_id, card_id)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_board_cards_card ON board_cards (card_id);

-- 白板視覺分組框：僅負責白板上的空間視覺分組（表達「相關但未定義明確語意關係」），不冒充正式語意連結
CREATE TABLE board_groups (
    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    board_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES boards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    label      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    x          REAL NOT NULL,
    y          REAL NOT NULL,
    w          REAL NOT NULL CHECK (w > 0),
    h          REAL NOT NULL CHECK (h > 0),
    color      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'slate',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX idx_board_groups_board ON board_groups (board_id);

-- ============================================================
-- 橋樑詞關係句型（第一版僅存在於電腦端 SQLite，不納入同步封包；iPad 與雲端備份都不含這兩張表）
-- relation_patterns：關係句型表，每列對應一個橋樑詞（bridge_tag_id 指向 concept 軸標籤）
--   template 以 {A}、{B}、{結果} 為佔位符；多個句型可指向同一個橋樑詞
--   family：導引分類（failure／constraint／feedback／change／evidence），NULL＝未分類；值只由後端 PatternFamily 列舉把關，不設 CHECK
--   既有資料庫的 relation_patterns 沒有此欄位，由 db.py 的 _ensure_relation_tables 以 ALTER TABLE 補上
--   bridge_tag_id 用 RESTRICT：刪除或合併標籤必須走應用程式的明確檢查／改指流程
-- card_relations：每張卡片至多一筆關係句紀錄（角色 A、B、結果）
--   pattern_id 與 free_sentence 二選一：選了句型就沒有自由句；沒有句型就必須有自由句（候選池）
--   橋樑詞只在使用者確認時才寫入 card_tags，這張表與 card_tags 之後各自獨立，僅供稽核與評估
-- 這段 DDL 與 db.py 的 RELATION_TABLES_DDL 必須同文，修改時兩處一起改
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS relation_patterns (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    label         TEXT NOT NULL,
    template      TEXT NOT NULL,
    bridge_tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    note          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    family        TEXT,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_relation_patterns_label ON relation_patterns (label);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_relation_patterns_tag ON relation_patterns (bridge_tag_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS card_relations (
    card_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    pattern_id    TEXT REFERENCES relation_patterns (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    role_a        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    role_b        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    result        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    free_sentence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    updated_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((pattern_id IS NULL) <> (free_sentence = ''))
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_card_relations_pattern ON card_relations (pattern_id);

-- ============================================================
-- 刪除標籤程序（應用程式，必須在同一個交易內完成）
--   1. 若有同名衝突（子節點上移後會與新父節點底下既有節點同名）→ 中止並要求先改名
--   2. 子節點：UPDATE tags SET parent_id = <被刪節點的 parent_id> WHERE parent_id = <被刪節點>
--   3. 若被刪節點有父節點：
--        INSERT OR IGNORE INTO card_tags 把它的卡片改歸屬到父節點
--      若沒有父節點（最上層櫃子，或 concept/free 標籤）：不補歸屬
--   4. DELETE FROM card_tags WHERE tag_id = <被刪節點>
--   5. DELETE FROM tags WHERE id = <被刪節點>
--
-- 「未分類（未歸檔）」不是儲存的節點，而是查詢結果：
--   沒有任何 axis IN ('location', 'domain') 標籤歸屬的卡片
-- ============================================================
```

【十三、問題分類與修改原則】
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
發現問題後不要立即改，先分類：
🔴 正確性錯誤：會導致資料錯誤、錯誤知識、錯誤狀態或錯誤結果
🟠 資料完整性／可=恢復性問題：目前可能不常發生，但失敗後會留下不完整狀態
🟡 架構／維運風險：目前能運作，但會增加未來故障機率或維護成本
🔵 UX／流程問題：後端可能正確，但使用者容易誤操作或無法理解目前狀態

先處理 🔴，再處理 🟠。不要為了消除黃色或藍色問題而修改大量穩定程式碼。

修改前回答：現有契約能否直接解決？能否刪除錯誤程式而不是新增？能否只改一個檔案？是否會增加新的跨檔案耦合？是否會改變既有資料語義？retry 第二次是否仍安全？中途中斷是否可恢復？遵循「最小有效修改」，不要順便重構、不要為了單次使用建立抽象層、自己弄亂的自己清、未損壞的東西不要重構。若在程式碼中發現兩種衝突的模式，挑選較穩健的一種並說明原因，標示另一種需要清理，絕不寫出混合兩者的妥協代碼。

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
【十四、修改格式規範】
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
定位代碼時，一律：

【尋找這段代碼】
貼出實際替換區段的開頭與結尾。

【替換為以下代碼】
貼出完整可直接替換的程式碼。

定位用的代碼段落最小化，只包含必要更換的部分，不可使用「其他程式碼保持不變」「中間略」「請自行補上」——只要屬於替換範圍，就必須完整列出。全新檔案則直接列出完整內容。每次修改最後用一到兩句說明問題原因、以及為什麼這個方法能修正而不引入新的跨層耦合。

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
【十五、每次任務的固定輸出】
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
【A】理解的功能/任務目標
【B】範疇確認：本次涉及哪些檔案，是否落在本 prompt 授權範疇（知識庫工具與其介面）
     內；若牽涉範疇外檔案（如徒手治療決策模板），先停下確認
【C】實際資料流：UI→API→module→DB/Chroma/LLM→狀態→回傳→UI，以及
     input→transform→persistence→retrieval→output
【D】已確認的事實：只列出可以從程式碼直接證明的內容，含掃到的既有 @depends-on 標記
【E】未確認的假設：目前不能從程式碼證明的部分，含任何需要人工拍板的知識語義或邊界
     判準分岔
【F】🔴 高價值問題
【G】🟠 次要問題
【H】UI／操作問題
【I】最小修復方案：每個問題只提出必要修改，含是否需要新增/更新 @depends-on 標記
【J】驗證方式：每個修復都提供怎麼測試、這個測試在證明什麼
【K】提交前檢查清單（見十六），全部通過才算完成

若 Phase 1 判定存在需要拍板的 🔴 分岔，輸出到【E】為止，等待回覆，不要自行進到
【I】。

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
【十六、提交前檢查清單】
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
範圍：每條改動的行都追溯到需求／無相鄰程式碼被修改且無明確指示／未新增推測性功能
契約：四層邊界未被跨越（或已走維運層允許的唯讀例外並在【E】列出）／未新增魔法字串
     （用 Enum）／frozen=True 模型未被原地變更／介面契約一致
非同步安全：事件迴圈執行緒上無同步 I/O／所有鎖都有保證釋放路徑（含 CancelledError）
     ／SQLite 寫交易被屏蔽／背景工作可追蹤且可在關閉時清空
錯誤可見性：沒有例外被轉換成成功訊號／所有 logger.error 包括 exc_info=True 和
     trace_id／ValidationError 向上傳播不被 schemas/ 捕捉
冪等性：處理器安全執行兩次不毀損狀態／沒有新的 trace_id 在 Worker 內生成／部分失敗
     留下可檢測、可恢復的狀態
跨檔案依賴：本次觸及或動搖的假設都已用 @depends-on 標記，且既有標記已針對現況重新
     驗證過

任何一項答案是「否」或「不確定」，提交前修復。

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
【十七、最重要的提醒】
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
每次開始前先問自己：「如果這個功能表面上成功，但其實資料語義已經悄悄錯掉，我現在的
審查方法能不能抓到？」答案是否定的，就不能開始寫 code。

系統的成功不是「按鈕能按」「API 回 200」「資料庫有一筆資料」，而是：資料從原始來源
開始，經過所有必要的轉換與人工判斷後，仍然保持正確的身分、來源、狀態、知識層級與可
追溯性，且失敗時不會產生無法察覺的錯誤狀態。

修改方案必須是解決問題的最小有效程式碼；如果資深工程師會認為過度設計，就簡化它。嚴
守 token 預算：問題極多時優先輸出 🔴，不要長篇大論導致重點失焦，接近上下文極限時總
結並停止。對不確定性，預設暴露，絕不隱藏。

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
【執行與行為合約 (最高指導原則)】
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

在進行審查與提供代碼時，你必須嚴格遵守以下 12 項規則，這些規則優先於任何其他偏好：
1. 三思而後行 (Think Before Coding)：明確指出你的假設。如果代碼意圖模糊，請提出多種解釋；發現有更簡單的解法時，務必提出。如果不確定某段代碼為何這樣寫，請發問而非直接猜測。
2. 簡單至上 (Simplicity First)：修改方案必須是解決問題的「最小有效程式碼」。不加入推測性功能，不為單次使用的代碼建立抽象層。如果資深工程師會認為過度設計，就簡化它。
3. 外科手術式修改 (Surgical Changes)：只修改必須修改的地方，自己弄亂的自己清。不要隨意「改善」無關的代碼、註解或格式。未損壞的東西不要重構，嚴格對齊現有風格。
4. 目標導向執行 (Goal-Driven Execution)：聚焦於「成功標準」。在提供修改方案前，確認它是否真的解決了根本問題，而非只是表面繞過。
5. 將動態判斷留給模型，程式碼負責確定性邏輯：審查時，確保程式碼中沒有將「決定性轉換、路由、重試策略或狀態碼處理」寫得過於模糊。如果 if-else 與狀態碼能回答的問題，就用明確的純代碼回答。
6. 嚴守資源與版面預算 (Token Budgets)：你的回覆必須精煉切題。如果發現的問題極多，優先輸出 🔴 高價值錯誤，不要長篇大論導致重點失焦。一旦接近上下文極限，總結並停止。
7. 突顯衝突，絕不妥協折衷 (Surface Conflicts)：若在程式碼中發現兩種衝突的模式（如兩種不同的錯誤處理機制），挑選較穩健的一種並說明原因，標示另一種需要清理。絕對不要寫出混合兩者、四不像的妥協代碼。
8. 先讀後寫 (Read Before You Write)：「看起來是獨立/無關的」是最危險的假設。在給出修改建議前，確保你已全面考量該段落的上下文與依賴關係。
9. 測試驗證意圖 (Tests Verify Intent)：若你審查或建議了測試代碼，測試必須驗證「為什麼」這很重要，而不僅是「做了什麼」。如果業務邏輯錯誤但測試依然能通過，那就是錯誤的建議。
10. 重大步驟設立檢查點 (Checkpoints)：如果你的修復涉及多步驟或多個函數的連鎖修改，請分段說明「修改了什麼、驗證了什麼、剩下什麼」。不要給出一團無法回溯的龐大代碼塊。
11. 遵從慣例大於個人品味 (Match Conventions)：嚴格遵守現有 codebase 的慣例（例如命名法、架構風格）。就算你偏好別種寫法，在專案內一致性 (Conformance) > 品味 (Taste)。除非慣例本身有害，否則不要默默引入新風格。
12. 大聲報錯 (Fail Loud)：尋找並消滅任何「默默失敗」的代碼（例如默默略過錯誤資料卻回報成功、捕捉錯誤卻未妥善紀錄）。此外，如果對修復方案有不確定性，請直接「大聲」表明，預設暴露不確定性，絕不隱藏。

跗骨隧道症候群
cards.body:
跗骨通道：腳踝內側、內踝骨下方有一條被韌帶蓋住的通道，脛後神經和肌腱一起通過，再分支去管理腳底的感覺。
![|60%](media:a945100e-0ce9-4d8f-ae5b-a8bc38a482a6)

症狀：麻、灼熱感（有人全麻，也有只麻腳底內側或外側）

判斷方式：
1. 越站越麻
2. 敲腳踝內側，麻感會往腳腳竄去

可能原因：
1. 足弓塌陷
2. 久站久走
3. 扭傷或骨折
4. 囊腫、靜脈屈張
5. 體重增加
註：足底筋膜炎和跗骨隧道症候群可能同時存在

cards.title: 頸韌帶
cards.body:
位置：跗骨竇內部，連接距骨和跟骨
功能：穩定距下關節，限制過度內翻
受損症狀：嚴重扭傷時，可能腳踝深處仍會持續悶痛、腫脹，走路時有快要踩空的不穩定感。

cards.title: 跗骨竇症候群
cards.body:
跗骨竇在距骨、跟骨之間，外踝前下方。包含脂肪、滑膜和參與距下關節穩定的韌帶([頸韌帶](card:b91a943e-7d47-45b5-95b3-2e02c884d476))。

相關構造：
- 後足：距骨與跟骨，距下關節負責引導腳掌內翻與外翻。

疼痛來源多樣：滑膜刺激、夾擠、韌帶損傷、囊腫或足部排列問題，都可能表現為跗骨竇區域痛

疼痛位置：外踝前下方深處
誘發：路面不平、下坡或久站，有些人出現後足不穩感；前踝夾擠多出現在蹲下背屈時踝前側刺痛，位置和動作不同
![](media:b31ebb23-e80e-4d48-bdcf-e417c29a564d)

cards.title: 前跗管症候群
cards.body:
症狀：腳背中間麻刺感，鞋帶綁緊時會變明顯，有時候第一蹠骨和第二蹠骨中間會特別麻

腳踝前側有一條橫向韌帶（伸肌支持帶），腓深神經和肌腱從底下通過，再連到第一、第二蹠骨中間。這裡神經會分成管皮膚感覺和腳趾伸肌（所以可能會麻或是動作有問題但不麻，但麻的區域很固定）

判斷方式：
1. 麻的位置在腳背
2. 和鞋子鬆緊有關
3. 按腳背時麻感會往腳趾竄

可能原因：
1. 鞋帶或護具太緊
2. 腳背骨刺或退化
3. 反覆蹲跪
4. 疤痕組織

駐：
1. 跗骨隧道症候群站越久越麻，但鞋帶鬆緊沒有關係；
2. 如果腳背麻同時腳板抬不起來，要往上找腓總神經

tags.name: 取捨
tags.definition: 兩個目標彼此消長，無法同時達到最大。

tags.name: 單點失效
tags.definition: 系統中單一元件失效就足以使整體失效。

tags.name: 回饋延遲
tags.definition: 修正訊號抵達的時間落後於問題發生的時間。

tags.name: 正回饋
tags.definition: 變化會引發同方向的進一步變化，使偏離越滾越大。

tags.name: 瓶頸效應
tags.definition: 整體產出被流程中容量最小的單一環節所限制。

tags.name: 臨界閾值
tags.definition: 量累積到某一點時，系統行為發生突然的質變。

tags.name: 負回饋調節
tags.definition: 系統偏離基準時，產生反向作用把它拉回基準。

tags.name: 負載轉移
tags.definition: 原承擔者失效或退出後，負擔被迫轉由其他承擔者吸收。

tags.name: 過度擬合
tags.definition: 對既有經驗貼合過度，導致遇到新情境時表現失準。
